verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Reclaim 2.0 note that you can 'preview changes in your calendar before deploying them' [reclaim-docs-52]. That is a dry-run of schedule changes on your real calendar, not an isolated sandbox environment with non-production data. Nothing shows a test or sandbox tenant for the API or the first-party MCP server, which documents only read/write/mcp OAuth scopes. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment, isolated test data for API/MCP agent testing, documentation of the preview mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
